entities.name: Kim Si-min
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kim Simin was a prominent Korean general during the Joseon period. He is most famous for having defended Jinju Castle against the Japanese invaders during the Seven Years' War. He came from the (old) Andong Kim clan.
